items.title: The Night Before: Game Nine vs. Delaware
items.summary: Kennesaw State returns home for a Conference USA battle against Delaware on Saturday, Nov. 7 at 3 p.m. on ESPN+. Get ready for kickoff with a week's worth of content leading up to gameday.

items.title: McKenzie Named to Ray Guy Midseason Watch List
items.summary: AUGUSTA, Ga. – Kennesaw State football punter Matt McKenzie has been named to the midseason watch list for the 2026 Ray Guy Award, which honors college football's top punter.

items.title: Kennesaw State Athletics Provides Design Update on Wellstar Champions Complex
items.summary: KENNESAW, Ga. – Kennesaw State Athletics announced Wednesday that the schematic design phase has been completed for the Wellstar Champions Complex, the 55,000-square-foot future daily home for Kennesaw State football.
